name: Pizzeria
note: Trattoria cream + tomato red with a live order kanban.
thesis: A neighborhood trattoria as a web page: warm cream paper, tomato red and basil green splitting the accent work, italic Georgia serifs, a pure-CSS checked-awning stripe, and white cards boxed in tan hairlines — with one live data surface baked into the storefront, a read-only order-tracker kanban that moves your ticket from the bench to the window while you watch.

tokens.bg: #FBF6EC warm cream page; cards #fff; recessed tiles + kanban gutters #F1E6D2; kanban wells return to the page cream; one dark #2B1F17 ink panel for the live-oven card header
tokens.fg: #2B1F17 espresso brown ink; secondary copy #6A5648 / #7A6656; muted meta + counts #9A8163; faintest #C9B79E (temp readout, empty-column dash)
tokens.accent: #B71C1C tomato red (kickers, prices, tag pills, primary CTA, awning stripe, ticket numbers) with #2E7D32 basil green as a true co-accent (wordmark tag, place-order button, YOU pill on #E3F0E4, done banner); #E0623B oven-orange and #4ADE80 live-dot as status tints
tokens.fontDisplay: literal Georgia, serif — bold everywhere, italic for the brand lockup and footer brand, -0.02em tracking on the 58px hero; body copy stays var(--font-sans)
tokens.fontMono: var(--font-mono) for ticket numbers, the 612°F oven readout, kanban column counts, and schedule hours — the data voice inside the trattoria voice
tokens.radius: generous rounded family: 10px small buttons + tickets, 12px CTAs + emoji glyph tiles, 14–16px cards, 18–20px hero peek card + tracker shell, 999px pills
tokens.border: #E7D9C2 tan 1px as the universal card/header/footer hairline; #F1E6D2 inner row dividers and the 1px gutter grid between kanban columns; #EADBC2 ticket borders with a 3px status-colored border-left; the footer closes on an emphatic 2px solid #2B1F17 rule
tokens.motion: one keyframe (mppizza-pulse: opacity 1→0.5→1, 1.8s infinite) on the hero's live dot; order progression is state-driven setTimeout stages (3s → oven, 6.5s → window) armed on click and cleared on unmount, not CSS; hovers are background-only fades

layout: Full-bleed cream page opened by a 14px red/cream repeating-linear-gradient awning stripe, then a sticky blurred-cream header (rgba cream + backdrop blur, tan hairline, kept under the gallery frame's z-index). Content lives in a single 1140px column with 28px side padding. Rhythm alternates 2-column grids (hero 1.1fr/0.9fr with the live-oven peek card, story 1fr/1fr with a 2x2 stat grid) against full-width 3-column grids (menu repeat(3,1fr) gap 18px; the kanban repeat(3,1fr) on a 1px #F1E6D2 gutter background faking column dividers). Density is airy trattoria-menu: 44–56px section padding, everything boxed in tan hairlines on white. The footer sits under a heavy 2px espresso rule with a mono demo-folio line beneath.

sections.name: awning + sticky header
sections.what: A 14px decorative awning band, then a sticky header: italic-Georgia 'Mom-n-Pops' + green uppercase 'Pizzeria' tag, and a right nav (Menu / Story / Find us / Track order) that smooth-scrolls to sections — 'Track order' is live: red, bold, with a lucide Radio icon.
sections.restyle: Hand-rolled. The awning is repeating-linear-gradient(90deg, #B71C1C 0 22px, #FBF6EC 22px 28px) — instant red-checker trattoria mood, zero assets. The header is rgba(251,246,236,0.92) + backdrop-filter blur(10px), sticky at z-index 20 (under the gallery frame), nav items as unstyled buttons calling ref.scrollIntoView.

sections.name: hero + live-oven peek
sections.what: Left: red uppercase kicker ('Wood-fired · Milwaukee · dal 2026'), 58px Georgia headline '60 seconds in a 900° oven.', lede, and two CTAs (red 'Start an order' scrolls to the menu, white-bordered 'Tonight's stop' scrolls to the schedule). Right: a white card 'The oven, right now' — dark ink header with pulsing green dot + mono 612°F, then a 3-row live queue (mono red ticket #, pie, green stage) under a '4 pies ahead · ~12 min' summary.
sections.restyle: Buttons flattened to the trattoria idiom: 12px radius, 13px/24px padding, 600 weight, no shadow — tomato solid vs white with tan border. The peek card is hand-rolled: 18px radius, deep soft shadow 0 18px 40px -22px rgba(43,31,23,0.4), #2B1F17 header band, the one CSS keyframe (mppizza-pulse) on the #4ADE80 dot.

sections.name: menu — Le Pizze
sections.what: Centered Georgia h2 with '10-inch personal pies · add to your order' sub-line, then a 3x2 grid of six white pie cards: 42px emoji glyph tile on #F1E6D2, optional colored tag pill, Georgia name vs bold red price on one baseline, one-line description, and a full-width '+ Add to order' button feeding the cart.
sections.restyle: Badge (solid) becomes the tag pill — 11px/700 white text, 999px radius, background driven per-item from data (tagBg: #2E7D32 / #B71C1C / #B3352E / #3F7D3A / #F0A202) via inline style; the untagged pie simply omits it. The add Button is restyled to a cream card action: full-width, #FBF6EC fill, 1px #D9C7A8 border, 10px radius, hover to #F1E6D2 — every click appends to cart state.

sections.name: order tracker (kanban surface)
sections.what: The special surface: a full-width white shell (20px radius) — header row with Georgia 'Track your order', live sub-line, a cart summary ('N in cart · $total', only when non-empty) and a green 'Place order' button — over a 3-column board: In line / In the oven / Out the window. Placing an order drops ticket #318 into 'In line', then timers walk it to the oven (3s) and the window (6.5s); at stage 2 a green banner announces 'Order #318 is up — come to the window! Grazie.'
sections.restyle: The react-fancy Kanban worn read-only: root regridded from flex/overflow to repeat(3,1fr) with a 1px gap on a #F1E6D2 background (the gutter IS the divider); unstyled Columns become cream #FBF6EC wells with hand-rolled headers (status dot #9A8163/#E0623B/#2E7D32 + bold label + mono count); unstyled Cards wrap white tickets with a 3px border-left inline-colored to their column. No onCardMove — state moves the tickets, not drags. The user's ticket adds a 2px green ring + a YOU Badge (10px/700 green on #E3F0E4). 'Place order' is a green Button with a REAL disabled prop (replacing the mockup's opacity/data-attr hack), flipping to 'Order placed ✓'. The done banner is a Callout flattened to a square-cornered full-width #E3F0E4 strip with a CircleCheck icon.

sections.name: story — La nostra storia
sections.what: A 2-column band above a tan top hairline: left is the red kicker + Georgia h2 'Sal built the oven. Rosa built the dough.' + one origin paragraph (two-day cold ferment, ninety seconds flat); right is a 2x2 grid of stat tiles — 30px extra-bold red values (90s / 2-day / 2026 / 6) over muted labels.
sections.restyle: Hand-rolled 'numbers as proof' tiles: white cards, tan hairline, 14px radius, stat values in the same tomato red as the menu prices so money, action, and proof share one color.

sections.name: find us — Dove siamo
sections.what: Georgia h2 over a single white card listing six Milwaukee evenings (Bay View → Humboldt Park) as ledger rows: bold day, muted neighborhood, mono hours.
sections.restyle: Hand-rolled 120px/1fr/auto grid rows divided by #F1E6D2 hairlines — reads like a printed hours card taped to the truck window; the mono hours column is the timetable tell.

sections.name: footer + demo folio
sections.what: Flex row under an emphatic 2px espresso rule: italic Georgia 'Mom-n-Pops Pizzeria', contact handles, '© 2026 · Rosa & Sal · Milwaukee'; beneath it a small mono demo-note line with a back-to-collection link.
sections.restyle: The 2px #2B1F17 top border is the page's heaviest stroke — a deliberate close against the 1px hairlines everywhere else. The demo folio stays in mono + muted tan so it reads as chrome, not content.

palette.restyle: Four wears, all 600 weight / auto height / no shadow: tomato-solid hero CTA (12px radius, hover deepens to #9D1616); white secondary with tan #E7D9C2 border; full-width cream '+ Add to order' card action (10px radius, #D9C7A8 border, #F1E6D2 hover); basil-green 'Place order' (10px radius) with a real disabled prop at 0.5 opacity.

A read-only status board, not a drag surface: root forced to a 3-up grid with 1px #F1E6D2 gutters; Columns unstyled → cream wells (min-height 230px, 14px padding) with dot + label + mono-count headers rendered as the first child; Cards unstyled → white 10px-radius tickets, 1px #EADBC2 border, 3px border-left inline-colored per column (queue #9A8163, oven #E0623B, up #2E7D32), green 2px ring when mine. Tickets migrate by re-rendering into a different column as order state advances.

Two reads: the menu tag pill (solid variant, 11px/700 white text, 999px radius, per-item background via inline style from data) and the YOU pill on the user's ticket (10px/700, #2E7D32 on #E3F0E4, 999px).
The 'order up' banner: color=green flattened hard — zero border, zero radius, full-width #E3F0E4 strip with #2E7D32 600-weight text and a CircleCheck icon — appearing only at the final order stage.
Only the demo-folio back link — tomato red, 600 weight, ArrowLeft glyph; everything else in-page scrolls via refs.

contentArchetype: A single-cuisine storefront with live ops for a fictional Milwaukee wood-fired pizza truck: hero promise ('60 seconds in a 900° oven.'), six ten-inch personal pies with prices and tags (Margherita $13 'The original' → Sausage & Peppers $16 'Local'), an embedded live order tracker (cart → place → In line → In the oven → Out the window → 'Grazie' banner), a division-of-craft origin story (Sal built the oven, Rosa built the dough) proven by four stats (90s / 2-day / 2026 / 6), a six-evening Milwaukee street schedule, and Italian section labels (dal 2026, Le Pizze, La nostra storia, Dove siamo) carrying the trattoria voice throughout.
remix: Retint the --mpp-* tokens to re-cuisine the whole truck: the load-bearing moves are (1) the repeating-linear-gradient awning stripe as a zero-asset brand device (swap stripe color + rhythm for any storefront), (2) cream paper + white cards boxed in tan hairlines with ONE dark ink panel for the live surface, (3) a two-accent system where red sells (prices, CTAs) and green confirms (place order, YOU, done) — keep that semantic split when recoloring, (4) italic Georgia as the family-business voice against mono data details, and (5) the read-only kanban recipe — any 3-stage fulfillment flow (coffee queue, barbershop, repair shop, kitchen display) drops onto the same unstyled-Kanban + cream-wells + bordered-tickets treatment with state-driven ticket migration. Blend toward a darker enoteca by inverting ink/cream; blend toward the taqueria sibling by trading Georgia for heavy tight sans and collapsing to a single accent.
